SELECT COUNT(*) AS sets, COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS set_codes,
       COUNT(s.totalSetSize) AS known_sizes,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.setCode) FROM main.set_translations AS t) AS codes_with_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.set_translations AS t WHERE TRIM(t.translation) = '') AS blank_names,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.language) FROM main.set_translations AS t) AS languages
FROM main.sets AS s;

arguments.sql:
WITH qualifying_sets AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.totalSetSize
    FROM main.sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY s.id, s.totalSetSize
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.translation) < 5
)
SELECT SUM(totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM qualifying_sets
LIMIT 1
